hero.title: Discover what you expose on the Internet before an attacker does
hero.description: Automated cybersecurity audits that identify exposed services, known vulnerabilities, and insecure configurations. No installations, no agents, just clear and actionable visibility.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card • Results in minutes • No commitment

problem.title: Many companies don't know what they're exposing
problem.subtitle: Most organizations are unaware of the real risks they face on the Internet. Without visibility, there is no control.

exposedServices.title: Exposed services without protection
exposedServices.description: Publicly accessible ports and services that shouldn't be, exposing sensitive data or administration interfaces.

sslTls.title: Misconfigured SSL/TLS certificates
sslTls.description: Expired certificates, obsolete protocols, or weak configurations that compromise communication security.

vulnerabilities.title: Unpatched known vulnerabilities
vulnerabilities.description: Known CVEs (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) that haven't been fixed, leaving systems exposed to attacks.

configurations.title: Insecure configurations
configurations.description: Dangerous default settings, missing security headers, or overly permissive access policies.

solution.title: Automate complex technical audits in minutes
solution.description: Odimetry scans your infrastructure from the outside, identifying real risks without requiring internal access or installations. We don't promise total security, but visibility and control over what you actually expose.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Complete audits in minutes, not days. Immediate results for quick decisions.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.description: Technical but understandable reports. No unnecessary noise, just what matters and how to fix it.

actionable.title: Actionable
actionable.description: Each finding includes context and concrete recommendations. Not just alerts, but solutions.

features.title: Technical features
features.subtitle: Tools designed for technical teams that need clear and actionable results.

domainAudit.title: Automatic domain audit
domainAudit.description: Enter a domain and get a complete analysis in minutes. No complex configuration or advanced technical knowledge required.

sslTls.title: SSL/TLS analysis
sslTls.description: Evaluates certificate configuration, supported protocols, cipher suites, and detects insecure or obsolete configurations.

ports.title: Port and service detection
ports.description: Identifies publicly exposed services, detectable versions, and configurations that could represent risks.

cves.title: Known vulnerabilities (CVEs)
cves.description: Compares your infrastructure with CVE databases to detect known vulnerabilities that require patches.

reports.title: Actionable reports
reports.description: Clear and technical documentation with specific recommendations. Not just alerts, but concrete solutions for each finding.

history.title: History and tracking
history.description: Compare audits over time to measure improvements and detect regressions in security configuration.

dashboard.title: Technical dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: View the security status of your domains in one place.
dashboard.cve1Description: Critical vulnerability in detected Apache version

target.title: Who Odimetry is for
target.subtitle: Designed for teams that value visibility and control over empty promises.

smes.title: SMEs
smes.description: Companies that need visibility into their Internet exposure without dedicated technical resources. Ideal for basic compliance and awareness.

startups.title: Startups
startups.description: Growing teams that prioritize speed but cannot afford security risks. Fast audits for informed decisions.

ctos.title: CTOs / DevOps
ctos.description: Technical professionals who need clear and actionable tools. No noise, just relevant technical data to improve security posture.

consultants.title: Technical consultancies and IT providers
consultants.description: Agencies that offer security services to clients. Fast external audits as part of their consulting services.

differentiators.title: Why Odimetry is different
differentiators.subtitle: External audits that don't require changes to your infrastructure.

items.actionable: Designed for action, not just alerts

differentiators.description: Odimetry scans from the outside, just like an attacker would. This means you don't need to install anything, configure agents, or give access to your internal systems. Just enter a domain and get clear, actionable results in minutes.

pricing.title: Plans and pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that best fits your needs. All plans include complete audits.

finalCta.title: Analyze your domain in minutes
finalCta.description: No installation, no commitment. Discover what you expose on the Internet and take control of your security.

noInstallation.title: No installation
noInstallation.description: No agents or internal access required

footer.description: Automated cybersecurity audits for companies that value visibility and control.

description.description: Odimetry provides automated cybersecurity audit services that scan domains from the outside to identify exposed services, known vulnerabilities, and insecure configurations. Our service is informative in nature and does not guarantee absolute security.
